_why: SPEC-207. The crawl on/off state used to live only in Supabase edge secrets — invisible in git, unreviewable, and unanswerable from the sandbox. Whether we were crawling was a question nobody could answer without opening a dashboard. It lives here now: committed, diffable, and reversible with one PR. CI pushes these into the edge-function runtime on every change.
_founder: 2026-08-02: 'activate the crawls just for the creator sources to get 100 of each then pause alongside the rest to audit.'
_CRAWLS_SUSPENDED: Global stop. false = the allowlist below decides. Defaults to SUSPENDED in code, so a typo here fails closed.
_CRAWLS_ONLY: ONLY these sources may run. The founder's order names creator sourceS, plural — there are exactly TWO (SPEC-230): ig_services (DUAL-CLASS: a service row AND a creator row per person, via ig-scraper-user-search) and se:web-harvest (creator-harvest, free keyless web search). Listing only ig_services here re-created the exact failure SPEC-230 documents — the last free path to the founder's creator target silently closed. se:web-harvest is not in the crawl rota (it is cron-driven, SPEC-237), but creator-harvest now reads this allowlist and refuses to run when its name is absent. ig-creator-marketplace stays REMOVED (SPEC-221). The other seven sources stay suspended until the audit clears them. yelp is PAUSED as a source, not deleted (founder, 2026-08-02: 'don't delete yelp.. just pause as a source') — it stays in the code and the dashboards, its rows are kept, and it simply stays out of this allowlist until the founder re-activates it.
_CREATOR_TARGET: EACH creator source stops ITSELF at this count — founder, 2026-08-02: 'get 100 of each then pause alongside the rest to audit.' ig_services counts eq(discovered_via, ig-scraper-user-search); creator-harvest counts by PREFIX like(discovered_via, se:web-harvest%) because its tag is stamped per run day (SPEC-237). Checked before any job is claimed / any search is fired, so neither can overshoot while nobody is watching.
_PHASE1_CITY_QUOTA: SET BY THE FOUNDER — a FORMULA, not a number (2026-08-02, verbatim: '50k services for nyc (with 5% of that as creators).. adjusting each city based on relative size of dma (eg: if miami is 10% of new it should be 5k services and 250 creators..'). services(city) = 50,000 × DMA(city)/DMA(NYC), DMA size in Nielsen TV households (2024-25 LTMUE), rounded to the nearest 100; creators = 5% of that (informational here — CREATOR_TARGET=100 is the standing get-100-then-audit order and governs creators until the founder lifts it). The value is a JSON map keyed by DMA code: NYC 7,494,510 households → 50,000; Miami 1,756,920 (23.4%) → 11,700. Phase 2 quotas are PRE-COMPUTED in the build spec (LA 38,900 · Chicago 24,400 · Dallas 21,800 · Philadelphia 21,000 · Houston 18,700 · Atlanta 18,400 · DC 17,600 · Boston 17,200 · Phoenix 14,700; 9th metro = Boston, founder 2026-08-02) but stay OUT of this map until Phase 1 is full — a DMA absent from the map cannot be crawled past phase gating. Both consumers (fulfill-crawl, _growth-scope.mjs) parse this map FAIL-CLOSED: empty, unparseable, or non-positive values mean Phase 2 stays locked. Refresh the numbers when Nielsen publishes new estimates.
_CONTACT_BAR_PCT: A source under 40% contactable is PARKED, not retried (founder, 2026-08-02).
